info.title: Accounting API Documentation
info.description: This is the API documentation for the Accounting Application.

get.summary: Get all budgets for the authenticated user
Get all transactions for a budget

200.description: List of transactions for the budget

post.summary: Add a transaction to a budget
Add a sub-user to a budget

get.summary: Get all transactions for a sub-user

post.summary: Add a transaction for a sub-user

get.description: Returns the count of active sub-users across all budgets for the authenticated user. Active sub-users are those with start date in the past or today, and either no end date or end date in the future, excluding Main Budget entries.

get.summary: Get all transactions for a sub-user with summary information

200.description: List of transactions with summary data

post.summary: Update payment status for a specific sub-user
Update payment status for multiple sub-users in a single request
Get data for multiple sub-users in a single request

get.summary: Get credit status for a sub-user
Get all transactions for the authenticated user

Resends the verification email to a registered user
